_meta.purpose: Q&A recovery recipes for the most common failure modes encountered while running pr-review. SKILL.md cites a sample subset; this file is the source of truth.
_meta.eviction_policy: preserve verbatim until count > 20; then fold non-recurring entries into a 'historical Q&A -- fixed' line citing last-PR/commit. Same one-shot eviction discipline as rationalization_table.json.

items.question: I'm on branch X but the PR says branch Y
items.answer: Run `git checkout <Y>`. Verify with `git log --oneline -5`. Re-run Phase 4 from Check 1.

items.question: BASE_SHA or HEAD_SHA is not on my current branch
items.answer: Your local is stale or you are on the wrong branch. `git fetch origin && git checkout -t origin/<headRefName>`. Re-run Phase 4.

items.question: Working tree is dirty
items.answer: Inspect each dirty file. Commit+push if it belongs to the PR; stash if it does not. Re-run Phase 4.
items.recovery_command: git diff <file>  # then commit-and-push, or git stash

items.question: The PR's base branch is not `main`
items.answer: Expected and fine. Record `baseRefName` verbatim from Phase 1 Check 1. Projects use integration branches (often `dev`) and feature-parents.

items.question: The PR has > 20 files. Should this skill scope the review?
items.answer: Scoping is mechanical in both skills. pr-review: `pr_review.py capture` scopes it (one slot per non-empty bucket plus triggered lenses and OVERALL); dispatch every printed row. pr-team: the orchestrator's PLAN mode scopes it from the same buckets and lens catalog; fan out every slot in its dispatch plan.

items.question: The user says they want HUMAN reviewers
items.answer: Do not use this skill. Run `gh pr edit <N> --add-reviewer @user` directly.

items.question: The reviewers returned findings -- now what?
items.answer: pr-review: Phase 3 runs `pr_review.py merge`, `amend` when needed, then `build` (writes the review JSON and runs the Phase 4 first run); Phase 5 then starts with the Phase 4 second run. pr-team: dispatch the orchestrator in CONSOLIDATE mode (Dispatch protocol step 3), which assembles the review JSON and runs the Phase 4 first run.
